description: This file defines custom attributes for redacting sensitive information in options classes, specifically 'RedactAttribute' and 'RedactConnectionStringAttribute'. The latter extends the former and provides a specific implementation for redacting connection strings.

classes.name: RedactAttribute
classes.description: An attribute used on properties to prevent their values from being formatted by IOptionFormatter instances.

classes.name: RedactConnectionStringAttribute
classes.description: A specialized attribute extending RedactAttribute, providing redaction specifically for connection string properties.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Returns a redacted string, defaulting to 'REDACTED' for RedactAttribute, and performing specific redaction for connection strings in RedactConnectionStringAttribute.
